## calendar_attributes

Repository: `gtfs.gtfsPlus.calendarAttributes`. Database table: `calendar_attributes`.

File: `calendar_attributes.txt` (optional).

### Fields

| Field                 | Returned value | Presence | Defaults and value rules              |
